create or alter procedure [graph].[Hop_GetResults] @diagramType int as begin -- Return to caller select distinct assetUid, assetId, [key], parentId, parentKey, back, fore, icon, assetTypeId, assetTypeUid, class, displayValue, reveal, actionCount, relationCounts, ownerCounts, useAsTransformation, isSubjectInTransformation, isLeaf, isFocal, hasAssetReadAccess, [level] from #nodes order by [Level];
if @diagramType = 1 begin select distinct [uid] ,case Direction when 'F' then ProvidedKey else [Key] end as subjectKey ,case Direction when 'F' then [Key] else ProvidedKey end as objectKey ,predicateId ,predicateUid ,[predicate] ,predicateType from #links where [Key] is not null and ProvidedKey is not null; end else begin select distinct [uid] ,ProvidedKey as subjectKey--,case Direction when 'F' then ProvidedKey else [Key] end as subjectKey ,[Key] as objectKey--,case Direction when 'F' then [Key] else ProvidedKey end as objectKey ,predicateId ,predicateUid ,[predicate] ,predicateType from #links where [Key] is not null and ProvidedKey is not null; end end
